title: Quick Filipino Cheese Skewers
description: A tangy and creamy Filipino dish featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese, perfect for a quick and energizing snack. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe uses an air-fry method on a robata-grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the shredded cheese, chopped spring onions, minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Thread a small amount of the cheese mixture onto each bamboo skewer, leaving a small space at the top.
Place the skewers on the robata-grill and air-fry for 5 minutes, turning occasionally.
Check the cheese for melting and browning, and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes if needed.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let cool for 1 minute.
Serve the cheese skewers hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional chopped spring onions if desired.
